name: pi-tui-tests
description: Dependency scope for the interactive tier. Deliberately separate from the package's own node_modules: node_modules/@earendil-works/* there are symlinks into the container's global pi install, and an `npm install` at the package root would reify that tree and prune them. Node resolves these two packages from test/tui/*.test.ts by finding this directory's node_modules first, so the package root is never touched.
